name: socialspire
description: Courses of tools built from what history's greatest founders actually did. Install the course that matches your week.

plugins.name: founder-led-sales
plugins.description: For a founder still doing the selling personally, whose deals stall in the middle. Sort the pipeline into who can actually say yes, prove the claim with the buyer supplying the input, count which objections actually kill deals, and hold the price when the buyer pushes. Four skills, each carrying a bank of verified historical cases.

plugins.name: getting-demand
plugins.description: For a founder whose product works and whose problem is that not enough people know. Count what your marketing actually says and cut to one, prove the claim your price rests on, decide whether to repeat or replace, and turn advertising money into units in hands. Four skills, each carrying a bank of verified historical cases.
